sources.snippet: Habibi: Laying the Open-Source Foundation of Unified-Dialectal Arabic Speech Synthesis This is an online demo for Habibi-TTS. Several notes: Use more qualified reference audio instead of default, ensure less than 12 seconds (use to clip) Provide an exactly matched reference text, which ends with proper punctuation, e.g. a period

sources.title: Habibi: Laying the Open-Source Foundation of Unified-Dialectal Arabic ...
sources.snippet: Habibi is a unified-dialectal Arabic TTS framework covering 12+ regional dialects. Our unified model matches or surpasses per-dialect specialized models and is highly competitive with ElevenLabs Eleven v3 (alpha).
